originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&irq` is never used.

presenceCondition:
(and (= CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE true)
     (= CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN true)
     (= CONFIG_OF_IRQ true))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_OF_IRQ () Bool
  true)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_47 (6252547b8a7.c), dead store on 'irq' at line 12 ('int irq = *ops'), now with CONFIG_OF_IRQ=true. When OF_IRQ=true, 'ops = &irq_domain_simple_ops' (line 22) makes ops non-NULL, so the dereference is safe. However, irq is still assigned and never subsequently used. In the real Linux irq_domain_add() code, irq would be used for IRQ domain setup. Simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug (NullDereference when TWL4030_CORE=true && OF_IRQ=false) does not apply here since OF_IRQ=true means ops is properly initialized.
